children: Climb Bio announced Phase 1 data for CLYM116 showing a ~29-day half-life and rapid, durable APRIL and IgA suppression with favorable tolerability.
Phase 1 healthy-volunteer study (N=46) showed ~29-day half-life for CLYM116, ~3x longer than sibeprenlimab.
Single 320 mg SC dose produced >90% free APRIL suppression and ~60–75% IgA/Gd-IgA1/IgM suppression through 12 weeks.
CLYM116 was generally well-tolerated: no serious adverse events, no dose-limiting toxicities, no hypogammaglobulinemia reported.
PK/PD modeling and formulation support 800 mg loading then 400 mg Q12W regimen; NAVIGATE-2 Phase 2 ongoing with initial data expected H1 2027.
Development readiness includes 200 mg/mL formulation enabling 400 mg single SC injection, pre-filled syringe complete, autoinjector in development.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
